track.title: Homayun: Kereshme Avaz
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: votes spread over five pitches; the Daramad votes a tone below the suggested D and the Forud a 4th below it. Vote kept.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on E in Kereshme Avaz. The line peaks at E5 (629.6 Hz) at 1:27.3. It closes on the tonic (E4 → E4 → Ds4 → Cs4 → Gs4 → E5).
